anomalies.description: Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat: the person in white initiates contact by grabbing and striking, while the person in brown actively resists, blocks, and counter-moves; both are upright and actively participating throughout this interval.

After the initial mutual struggle, the person in white gains dominance and continues to strike and push the other individual, who is now off-balance and falling, culminating in them being knocked to the ground and lying helpless while the attacker remains over them—indicating an attack on a helpless victim.

Two individuals are engaged in a physical struggle on the ground, with one person repeatedly striking or pressing down on the other who is lying prone; the interaction includes rolling, grappling, and sustained close contact consistent with mutual combat.

After initial grappling, one individual appears to dominate and repeatedly strike or压制 the other who remains largely immobile on the ground, suggesting the victim is helpless and the attacker is continuing aggression without resistance.

Two individuals are engaged in a physical altercation on the ground: one person (wearing dark top, jeans, pink shoes) is on top of another (wearing white top), grappling, pinning, and striking repeatedly. The sequence shows dynamic struggle with shifting positions but continuous mutual combat.

After initial mutual engagement, the person on top (dark top) appears to dominate and continue aggressive actions against the person underneath (white top), who is largely supine and unable to effectively resist—indicating a shift from mutual fighting to one-sided abuse.

Two individuals are engaged in a physical struggle on the ground; one person (in dark top) is on top of the other (in white top), grappling, pinning, and attempting to control them across multiple frames. Movements include shifting positions, pulling hair or head, and attempts to gain dominant posture — consistent with mutual combat.; Two individuals engage in a sustained physical altercation: one in dark clothing and red shoes repeatedly grabs, lifts, and strikes the other person (wearing white top and dark pants), who attempts to resist, break free, and counter-attack. The struggle involves grappling, pulling hair, and dynamic repositioning across the pavement and near a wall.; Two individuals engage in a physical altercation: the person in the white hoodie initiates contact, they grapple, and the person in dark clothing gains control, taking the other to the ground and maintaining dominance through repeated strikes or holds.

After being taken down (around f4), the person in the white hoodie is on the ground and appears helpless while the attacker in dark clothing continues to strike or压制 them, consistent with abuse of a defenseless victim.

After the initial struggle, the person in dark clothing maintains dominant control over the person on the ground (white shirt), who appears increasingly subdued and unable to effectively resist—indicating a shift from mutual fighting to one-sided assault against a helpless victim.

Two individuals are engaged in a physical altercation: one person (in dark clothing) is on top of another (in white shirt and dark pants), repeatedly striking or pressing down while the other is on the ground, struggling and attempting to defend themselves. The interaction involves grappling, pinning, and forceful contact consistent with mutual combat.

Two individuals are engaged in a physical altercation on the ground; one person (in dark clothing) is on top of the other (in white shirt), repeatedly striking or pressing down while the other attempts to defend or resist. The struggle continues across all frames with dynamic repositioning but sustained close combat.; Initial physical struggle where both individuals appear engaged in mutual grappling before one gains clear dominance; early frames show reciprocal contact and resistance.; Initial physical struggle where both individuals appear engaged; the person on top may be attempting to subdue the other, with some resistance visible before the victim becomes largely immobilized.

After initial mutual engagement, the person in dark clothing gains dominant control over the other, who appears increasingly subdued and unable to effectively resist—suggesting a shift from mutual fighting to one-sided abuse, particularly evident from frame f3 onward as the victim remains on the ground while being struck or restrained.; A person in dark clothing is repeatedly striking and pinning down another person lying on the ground, who appears unable to defend themselves or escape; the attacker maintains dominant position throughout the sequence.

A person in dark clothing is straddling and repeatedly striking or pressing down on another person lying on the ground, who appears unable to resist or escape.; After the main assault phase, the attacker stands up while the victim remains on the ground; a third person enters frame (f12–f15) and appears to intervene or assist the victim, suggesting the victim is still incapacitated or vulnerable.
